title: Multimodal cell atlas of the ageing human skeletal muscle
donors: 31 biopsied participants (17 male, 14 female; Spain and China); post-QC multimodal dataset: 22 individuals
cells: 292,423 sc/snRNA-seq profiles (212,774 snRNA-seq nuclei + 79,649 scRNA-seq cells); 95,021 snATAC-seq nuclei; 387,444 combined modality profiles
age_range: 15–99 years; adults 15–46 (n=12), older adults 74–99 (n=19); median ages 36 and 84 years
fitness_frailty_metadata: Supplementary Table 1 provides 31 donor rows (17 male, 14 female; European n=18, Asian Chinese n=13; age range 15–99). Supplementary Table 2 provides 190 library records: 38 scRNA-seq, 106 snRNA-seq and 46 snATAC-seq, with aggregate counts matching the article (79,649; 212,774; 95,021). One scRNA donor code (YM5) has no matching Supplementary Table 1 row; crosswalk unresolved.
assays: scRNA-seq of isolated mononucleated cells; snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq from snap-frozen biopsies; integrated peak-to-gene links and cell-type differential accessibility
cell_type_annotations: 15 main sc/snRNA-seq populations and 11 snATAC-seq populations; myofibres/myonuclei, MuSCs, FAPs, fibroblast-like cells, adipocytes, pericytes, SMCs, endothelial, myeloid/lymphoid/mast immune cells and Schwann cells; finer subtypes in portal/paper
genome_build: Not applicable to metadata supplements. The snATAC peak-coordinate build for selected HLMA portal objects remains unknown; inspect object metadata before variant overlap.
processed_data_locations: Saved official portal API snapshot maps all 23 targeted object rows to 16 portal-reported OMIX paths and all 46 snATAC-fragment rows to 10 paths across OMIX004305/OMIX006021; together, the 69 listing rows expose 26 distinct OMIX path IDs. This is URL metadata only. Official-record conflicts include four fragment sample-label mismatches, portal-row/release sample-count differences for OMIX004305-02/-03/-04 and OMIX006021-06, P27/P17, Myofiber/Myonucleus size-title conflict, and China size/title mismatch. No object/archive bytes were downloaded; see the raw listing snapshot, inventory and dated crosswalk audit.
raw_accessions: Study-level CNP0004394; CNP0004395; CNP0004494; CNP0004495. Portal OMIX archive IDs are not CNP accessions; per-file CNP mapping remains UNKNOWN.
license: PMC article-version metadata states CC BY for article supplements. OMIX pages report Open-access data but no specific reuse license; HLMA processed-object reuse terms remain unverified.
limitations: Small descriptive atlas, not an independent GWAS/QTL replication. Portal link paths identify 23 object-row and 46 fragment-row archive targets, but do not verify bytes or archive members. Release cross-check flags four fragment donor-label conflicts, four portal-row/release sample-count differences, P27/P17, Myofiber/Myonucleus title-size mismatch, and China title-size mismatch. YM5 remains unmatched; per-file CNP mapping, selected-object coordinate build and reuse terms remain unknown. No downstream molecular analysis before eligible loci.

title: Human skeletal muscle aging atlas
fitness_frailty_metadata: No fitness/frailty measure identified in reviewed article text; donor-level hospital/ventilation context is material
cell_type_annotations: 40 major human muscle populations; includes MuSCs, myofibers, fibroblasts, smooth muscle, pericytes, endothelial, adipocyte, Schwann, immune and myonuclear subtypes
genome_build: Not applicable to expression objects; variant-coordinate build not reported
raw_accessions: ArrayExpress E-MTAB-13874 (new raw libraries); supporting data derived in part from GSE143704, GSE167186 and DRYAD 10.7272/Q65X273X
license: Article CC BY 4.0; processed H5AD object-specific terms not stated on atlas portal (do not assume article license covers hosted objects)
limitations: Primary author-hosted portal lists one processed human atlas and six subset H5AD downloads (direct requests returned application/x-hdf, confirming HDF content type only; no bytes/schema/license audit). Nature article reports 17 donors, 90,902 cells and 92,259 nuclei; no frailty/fitness phenotype identified, and most donors received CPAP or mechanical ventilation. Suitable only for locus/gene cell-context after upstream gates pass. See analysis/muscle_ageing_atlas_access_terms_audit_2026-09-24.md

title: Single-Nucleus RNA Sequencing Reveals Muscle Fiber Cell Heterogeneity During Human Skeletal Muscle Aging
donors: 8 Chinese male participants: 5 adults aged 22–60 years and 3 elderly aged 99–101 years
cells: 80,277 captured; 71,373 nuclei retained after QC (article methods/results)
fitness_frailty_metadata: Reports SPPB, DXA skeletal muscle index, hand-grip strength and walking pace; no validated frailty instrument or sleep phenotype. Eight-donor, male-only, extreme-age contrast.
assays: 10x Chromium 3-prime snRNA-seq (v3); no snATAC or QTL assay reported
cell_type_annotations: Myofiber subtypes, MuSCs, FAPs, pericytes, endothelial cells, macrophages, lymphocytes and mast cells (article reports nine groups/subtypes)
processed_data_locations: No processed expression matrix or cell-object repository identified in article data statement; article provides a 36.4-MB Word supplement with figures. Do not treat raw reads as a processed matrix.
raw_accessions: NGDC GSA-Human HRA009010 (reported in article); direct study-page/access status was not independently verified in this audit.
license: Article is CC BY 4.0; this does not independently establish reuse terms for HRA009010 sequence data.
limitations: Eight male donors with an extreme age contrast limit generalizability; measures are functional context, not a validated frailty case definition. Article reports raw data at HRA009010 but general GSA-Human documentation describes controlled human-data access; exact accession access status and any processed-object availability require direct verification. No project loci are eligible for downstream lookup.

title: Multiomics and cellular senescence profiling of aging human skeletal muscle uncovers Maraviroc as a senotherapeutic approach for sarcopenia
donors: 10 male donors reported in article; 20 GEO records are paired GEX and ATAC modality records for five young and five aged biological replicates
cells: 52,934 qualified nuclei reported by article; count matrices are separated by donor/modality
nuclei: Single-nucleus multiome (RNA+ATAC), paired assays from 10 donors
age_range: Young 19–27 years; aged 60–77 years, per article
fitness_frailty_metadata: Young vs aged only; no validated frailty/fitness phenotype reported in source reviewed; surgery indication differs between groups (ACL reconstruction vs knee replacement)
assays: 10x Chromium single-nucleus multiome; gene expression and chromatin accessibility
cell_type_annotations: Nature Communications primary article reports 12 clusters: MuSCs; FAP1 and FAP2; EC1, EC2 and EC3; pericytes; SMC1 and SMC2; macrophages; B/T/NK cells; and a small number of mature skeletal muscle nuclei (MSMs). These are article-level labels; a barcode-to-cell annotation map for the GEO matrices remains unverified.
genome_build: hg38 (Assembly reported in all 20 GEO sample records; equivalent reference label GRCh38)
processed_data_locations: Official GEO GSE268953: 10x Cell Ranger ARC barcodes/features/matrix processed count files per biological sample and modality; GEO page lists 20 sample records. Approx. 1,877 MB supplementary data for whole BioProject; files not downloaded. Sample metadata crosswalk (20 GEO records): manifests/muscle_gse268953_sn_multiome_sample_crosswalk.tsv; official MINiML snapshot and checksum provenance under manifests/source_metadata/GSE268953/.
license: GEO public; no separate data reuse license identified. Article license does not automatically establish deposited-data terms.
limitations: Small all-male cohort; group and surgery indication confounded; no validated frailty phenotype or genetic/QTL evidence; article cluster labels are known but barcode-to-cell mapping remains unverified; matrix files are large; no eligible project loci. GEO MINiML has no per-sample exact age or sex; its sample-level cell type is only broad “muscle mononuclear cell”. All 20 processing records list hg38.

title: Single nuclei profiling identifies cell specific markers of skeletal muscle aging, frailty, and senescence
donors: 17 snRNA-seq samples/donors; GEO titles identify 11 OldHM (HM1, HM2, HM3, HM4, HM6, HM7, HM9, HM11, HM12, HM15, HM23) and six YouHM (HM5, HM8, HM10, HM13, HM21, HM22); GSM5098737–GSM5098753
cells: Primary paper: 143,051 post-QC/preprocessed/aligned nuclei transcriptomes (93,406 old; 49,645 young); later reanalyses report ~97k–102k under differing QC pipelines
nuclei: snRNA-seq; 143,051 transcriptomes in primary paper after its QC/preprocessing/alignment
age_range: Young: 19–22 years (n=6); Old: 70–90 years (n=11), with exact donor ages in manifests/muscle_gse167186_snRNA_donor_crosswalk.tsv
fitness_frailty_metadata: GEO snRNA sample attributes include age, age group and tissue; no sex or donor-level validated frailty/sarcopenia field is listed. Do not transfer bulk-cohort categories to these 17 donors.
assays: 10x single-nucleus RNA-seq; matched study bulk RNA-seq and spatial profiling are separate data types
cell_type_annotations: Primary paper: seven clusters—type II fibers, type I fibers, FAPs, satellite cells, smooth muscle cells, endothelial cells, and immune cells (macrophages, T/NK); downloadable annotation-to-barcode map not verified
genome_build: GRCh38 in all 17 official GEO MINiML sample processing records
processed_data_locations: Official GEO lists per-sample count CSVs and filtered 10x H5 matrices; no expression matrix downloaded. Official 9.9 KB simplified sheet and 10.6 KB MINiML snapshots, hashes and donor-level crosswalk are preserved under manifests/source_metadata/GSE167186 and manifests/muscle_gse167186_snRNA_donor_crosswalk.tsv.
license: GEO public; no separate reuse license identified. Article is open access; deposited-file terms not independently verified.
limitations: Small snRNA age contrast (6 young, ages 19–22; 11 old, ages 70–90). GEO sample attributes do not list sex or a clinical frailty/sarcopenia phenotype; parent bulk-cohort labels remain unmapped. Cell annotations in count matrices not checked; no independent GWAS evidence or eligible project loci. GEO age for OldHM23 is 90, above the article’s reported 65–85 older-adult recruitment band; discrepancy unresolved. Primary-paper 143,051 post-QC transcriptomes differ from later ~97k–102k reanalysis totals under distinct QC pipelines; do not compare as like-for-like counts.

title: A reference single-cell transcriptomic atlas of human skeletal muscle tissue reveals bifurcated muscle stem cell populations
tissue: human skeletal muscle from diverse anatomical sites
cells: GEO provides a 429.3 KB cell/sample metadata file; article reports thousands of profiled cells; exact post-QC count not extracted here
age_range: Donor age fields are in GEO metadata; numeric range not extracted in this audit
fitness_frailty_metadata: No frailty phenotype identified; descriptive muscle-cell reference only
cell_type_annotations: Study annotates muscle stem-cell and resident-cell populations; mapping to sample-level GEO metadata requires direct metadata inspection
genome_build: Not reported in series record; gene-expression matrix is not a variant-coordinate resource
processed_data_locations: Official GEO GSE143704 metadata (429.3 KB), normalized expression (2.1 GB), and raw count expression (38 MB); files not downloaded.
license: Article reports CC BY 4.0; GEO deposited-data terms not independently identified.
limitations: Reference atlas across diverse muscle sites, not a clean age contrast; donor age, sex, tissue site and cell labels require sample-level mapping; large normalized matrix; no frailty or genetic/QTL evidence.
